---
title: "SETAC DRAW Model Prediction Report"
output: html_document
params:
  dat: NULL
  res: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(knitr)
```

## User Inputs

```{r user-inputs}
if (!is.null(params$dat)) {
  knitr::kable(params$dat)
} else {
  cat("No user input provided.")
}
```

## Prediction Plot

```{r prediction-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
if (!is.null(params$res$p)) {
  params$res$p
}
```

## Prediction Table

```{r prediction-table}
if (!is.null(params$res$fitdat)) {
  knitr::kable(params$res$fitdat, digits = 4)
}
```
